## Klaven Marine Captain (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
Klaven fighter 5  
LE Medium humanoid (aquatic, augmented humanoid, locathah)  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+4 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)  
**hp** 91 (7d8+35)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +3, **Will** +6  
**Defensive Abilities** energy modulation, plagueborn; **Immune** disease, fear  
**Weaknesses** malign influence  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** +1 longspear +12 (1d8+8/×3) or 2 claws +9 (1d6+4)  
**Ranged** mwk spur rifle +8 (1d6/19-20 plus poison) or javelin +7 (1d6+4)  
**Special Attacks** weapon training +1 (spears)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 14, **Con** 16, **Int** 11, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 25  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Furious Focus, Iron Will, Outflank, Weapon Focus (longspear), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Intimidate +10, Perception +7, Stealth +6 (+10 in forests and jungles), Survival +7, Swim +16; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Intimidate, +4 Stealth in forests and jungles  
**Languages** Jagladine  
**SQ** amphibious, armor training, converted host, nanite exchange  
**Gear** glassteel helmet, masterwork light trooper armor, masterwork spur rifle with 12 spurs, javelins (2), +1 longspear
